lines.text: Asaph calls God the Shepherd of Israel and asks Him to restore His people and make His face shine.
Asaph asks how long God's anger will smolder, saying God fed them the bread of tears while enemies mock them.
God uprooted a vine from Babylon, cleared the ground, and it filled the land, sending branches to the Sea.
Asaph asks why God broke down the vine's walls, lets a lion ravage it, and begs Him to look down from heaven.
Asaph asks for God's hand on the man at His right hand, promising that they will call on His name.
